item.text: [{"task_id":"458e3a53","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    step = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    minimum = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    fraction = float(params['uniformity'][0])","    blank = int(round(params['fallback'][0]))","    if step <= 0:","        return np.array([[blank]], dtype=int)","    height, width = grid.shape","    rows = [-step]","    cols = [-step]","    for r in range(height):","        if np.all(grid[r, :] == grid[r, 0]):","            rows.append(r)","    for c in range(width):","        if np.all(grid[:, c] == grid[0, c]):","            cols.append(c)","    rows.append(height)","    cols.append(width)","    rowspans = []","    colspans = []","    for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):","        if b - a - step >= minimum:","            rowspans.append((a + step, b))","    for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):","        if b - a - step >= minimum:","            colspans.append((a + step, b))","    cells = []","    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(rowspans):","        for j, (c, d) in enumerate(colspans):","            block = grid[a:b, c:d]","            color = int(block[0, 0])","            if np.count_nonzero(block == color) == block.size * fraction:","                cells.append((i, j, color))","    if not cells:","        return np.array([[blank]], dtype=int)","    top = min(cell[0] for cell in cells)","    bottom = max(cell[0] for cell in cells)","    left = min(cell[1] for cell in cells)","    right = max(cell[1] for cell in cells)","    output = np.full((bottom - top + step, right - left + step), blank, dtype=int)","    for i, j, color in cells:","        output[i - top, j - left] = color","    return output"],"shapes":{"geometry":[2],"uniformity":[1],"fallback":[1]},"params":{"geometry":[1,2],"uniformity":[1],"fallback":[0]},"rationale":"Find uniform separator rows and columns, identify monochromatic blocks, and return their colors within their compact bounding rectangle. Geometry encodes separator width and minimum block extent; uniformity requires every pixel in a selected block to match. Zeroed tensors produce a singleton fallback, and randomized uniformity rejects the demonstration blocks. The test yields [[8,2],[2,6],[1,1]]."}]
